text: dsh-client-ui-model-search 是一个面向 DSH 网页客户端的模型选择界面插件。它通过注入会话输入区的模型选择插槽，使用 DSH 共享的模型目录呈现可搜索的选择菜单。用户可以按模型名称、ID、描述或提供方信息筛选模型，折叠提供方分组，并为支持的模型选择推理等级。选择操作沿用共享目录的选择流程，界面提供中文和英文文本并适配 DSH 主题。适合模型列表较长、需要快速定位或管理不同提供方模型的网页端用户。安装需要兼容的 DSH Web profile 和 Node.js 版本；代码没有读取 API key 或直接调用外部服务。

dsh-client-ui-model-search adds search and collapsible provider groups to the DSH web model picker. Users can filter the shared list and select models or reasoning effort. The bilingual UI follows DSH themes. Requires a web profile and Node.js; no API key is read.
DSH 网页端的模型太多了，能不能按名称快速搜？
How can I collapse provider sections in the web model picker?
dsh-client-ui-model-search 的功能「搜索模型」：在网页端模型菜单输入查询词，按模型名称、ID、描述及提供方名称或 ID 筛选结果。搜索会同时匹配多个空格分隔的词，并显示匹配的模型。
dsh-client-ui-model-search 的功能「分组选择模型」：模型菜单按提供方显示分组，可点击标题折叠或展开，并选择模型；若当前模型提供推理等级，还能在菜单中切换等级。

dsh-client-ui-model-search README · dsh-client-ui-model-search：A small client UI plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that makes the web composer's model selector usable at scale:

dsh-client-ui-model-search README · dsh-client-ui-model-search：- 🔍 **Search box** at the top of the model list — filters as you type.
  - Tokenized AND matching: `opencode-go deepseek` finds OpenCode Go's DeepSeek models (hyphens and underscores are treated as spaces).
  - Matches model name, model id, description, provider name, and provider id.
- 🗂️ **Collapsible provider groups** — click a group header to collapse/expand it. A count badge shows how many models a group holds.
- 🌗 **Theme-aware** — uses DSH design tokens (`--dsw-*`), so light/dark follows the active theme.
- 🌐 **Bilingual** — zh-CN and en dictionary via the official `locale` service.
- ♻️ **Non-destructive** — registers on the official `conversation.input.model` seat with `priority: -1`, so the shipped selector stays mounted underneath as a fallback. Uninstall (or stop the plugin) and the native selector returns.
dsh-client-ui-model-search README · dsh-client-ui-model-search：> **Not an official DeepSeek product.** No endorsement, review, or store listing by DeepSeek.

dsh-client-ui-model-search README · How it works：The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` package owns a per-session `ModelDirectory` service (`ctx.modelDirectories`) shared by the composer model seat and the `/model` popup. This plugin reuses that exact directory — including `select()` — so a picked model lands on the standard `directory.select()` path and stays in sync with `/model`.

dsh-client-ui-model-search README · Install：Requires a DSH profile with the web UI.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-client-ui-model-search
```

Then restart the profile:

```sh
dsh --profile <name> web
```

Open the model selector in the composer (bottom-right). The search box appears above the model list; group headers are clickable.

dsh-client-ui-model-search README · Local checkout：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-client-ui-model-search
```

dsh-client-ui-model-search README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-client-ui-model-search
```

Restart the profile: the native selector returns (it was never removed).
dsh-client-ui-model-search README · Screenshots：`demo.html` renders the exact menu UI (same CSS classes and mock data) standalone in any browser — open it to take additional screenshots.

dsh-client-ui-model-search README · Compatibility notes (DSH is pre-release)：- The package is authored against the official bundle format: `package.json` `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`, plus a `dsh.client` web entry, matching `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection@0.1.1-rc.2`.
- `dsh-plugin.json` is a **Community Draft v0.15** manifest ([dsh-std](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-std), schema validated). It declares a no-op `host` facet because the v0.15 draft has no web-slot contract; the composer-seat contribution therefore rides the official web slot, not a dsh-std contract. When upstream adds a web contract, this can be upgraded.
- If upstream renames `conversation.input.model` or the `modelDirectories` service, this plugin stops taking effect (and the native selector simply stays). That is the documented cost of riding an official seam; the dsh-std adapter path is the mitigation once a web contract lands.
